name: The Engineering Firm
description: Each engineer at the firm leads a different project in a different discipline. Work out who's building what.
clues: Hertz's budget is exactly $20k more than the engineer using Aluminum.
The engineer using Copper's budget is higher than both Edison and the engineer using Steel.
Edison's budget is higher than both Watt and the engineer using Concrete.
Diesel's budget is immediately next to the engineer using Aluminum.
The engineer using Steel's budget is immediately below Diesel.
Hertz has a higher budget than the engineer using Copper.
